source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted Windows build configuration defaults to Linux workers and uses linux64-7zz for its cross-build tasks. The win64 coverage task overrides the worker to b-win2022 and fetches win64-7zz. Keep target platform and tool host distinct. These explicit fetch declarations do not establish that later repackage, localization or search jobs were covered by the original port.
title: Windows-target builds fetch 7zz for the worker host, with a native coverage exception
